_rationale: Balanced portfolio (6.5% mean, 10.5% stddev) with 3% inflation makes this harder than it looks. The 60k/yr spending inflates to ~108k at age 75 and ~146k at age 85 (in nominal terms). Virginia state tax now uses graduated brackets (2–5.75%) above a $16k MFJ std deduction, with a $24k MFJ age-65+ retirement-income exclusion — lower than the prior flat 5.75% on gross, so success probability lands a few points higher than under the old flat-rate model. SS at 67 adds ~23k/yr (30k × 0.77 haircut, before-tax) but can't offset the growing spending gap. Pre-retirement savings of $30k/yr for 5 years help. Bracket inflation indexing (post-2026 federal + VA brackets) reduces tax drag in late years. Probability should be in the 20-65% range.
